title: Uniform Remix 솔로 #176 · 교복 · 마이크로 비키니 탑 × 서스펜더 초미니(얇은 멜빵) · 힐 · powerlifter bombshell · 3/4 각도·팔 위로 · 배경 만리장성 · 코갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, early 30s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, voluminous curls honey blonde hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a micro bikini top of two tiny triangle cups of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with thin navy piping, held by thin navy strings tied behind her neck and back, with a small gold crest bead between the cups, her shoulders, arms and midriff bare, and an ultra-micro mini skirt of ultra-thin matte pale-blue modal jersey held up by two thin suspender straps that rise from the waistband and cross over her shoulders, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending a hand-width below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the clean edges of the suspender skirt and its thin straps, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, her legs fully in view — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy pale blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in pale blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed far beyond the extreme, every element exaggerated to the maximum: a thick opaque white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line over the whole lid and up past the brows to the temples, a wide thick white band painted under both eyes, enormous bright turquoise liner wings flaring far beyond the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes in double layers top and bottom, thick opaque glossy white lips with a sharp outline.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows tanning oil sheen, golden bronzed glistening skin.

Background: a sunlit stretch of the Great Wall of China with worn brick paving, waist-high crenellated parapet, standard-height arched gate and stone steps, empty of tourists, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
